name: Saya Friday
source:
Saya Friday is a young noble lady from Leazas, belonging to the Friday family and also [url=/c50974]Patty the Summer[/url]'s sister. Along with other Leazas nobles, she has an intense dislike over the queen [url=/c11980]Lia Parapara Leazas[/url], and directly acted against her even before she was crowned as the queen.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Saya_Friday]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
